body.x: Sky Digital (President Jung-Sik Bae, www.skydigital.co.kr) presented its world-class Personal Data Security Solution AES-256 and Mechanic LED Gaming Keyboard/Mouse at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

The Mechanic LED Gaming Keyboard/Mouse was manufactured with the authentic Cherry MX switch from Germany. The number of USB connection and data input is unlimited with N-Key Rollover. There are many modes it supports such as the Equalizer Mode which automatically equilizes sound, and a powerful and colorful LED effect on each key that can be switched on or off to distinguish the keys that are often used or not used.

Additional software installation is unnecessary. This world-class Mechanic LED Gaming Keyboard shows off professional QTLA hardware macro 8 key for all systems, ultra polling rate of 1000HZ that allows data transfer between the PC and the keyboard 1000 times per second, 10 levels of speed control, and the special key "G" to quickly change to game mode.
Furthermore, Step Sculpture 2 type key cap layout reduces fatigue, while volume control and muting hot key are also built in the system.

Personal Data Security Solution AES-256 adopted the U.S. government’s top-secret AES 256-bit encryption algorithm and is free from OS, providing independent, real-time hardware encryption. Also, 100 million 4 to 8 digits password combinations can be made, and the device is compatible with any device supporting a USB host. Emergency data recovery is also possible with a master key.

AES-256 comes equipped with easy-input electrostatic touch pad, ARM base 32-bit controller, hardware safety removal system, mounting/dismounting option, USB 3.0 super-speed, and SATA I/II/III/6Gbps SATA3, while the menu, HDD information, and temperature are displayed on its OLED window.

Since the company’s founding in 1999, Sky Digital has developed, manufactured, and distributed creative and useful products using its strong R&D and sales distribution structure as its foundation. Based on the company’s licensed techniques, its security and gaming input products are widely recognized in the international market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.

Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.
